record.original_question: Fix a klt pair (X, Delta). Does there exist a positive constant epsilon such that for every (K_X + Delta)-nonnegative birational map X --> X' and every point x in X', the normalized volume of x in (X', Delta') satisfies vol^(x, X', Delta') >= epsilon?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\Delta)$ be a klt pair, i.e. $X$ is a normal quasi-projective variety over $\mathbb{C}$ and $\Delta$ is an effective $\mathbb{Q}$-divisor on $X$ such that $K_X+\Delta$ is $\mathbb{Q}$-Cartier and the pair has Kawamata log terminal singularities. For a closed point $y$ on a klt pair $(Y,\Delta_Y)$, the normalized volume of $y$ is
$$\widehat{\mathrm{vol}}(y,Y,\Delta_Y)\;=\;\inf_{v}\;A_{(Y,\Delta_Y)}(v)^{\dim Y}\,\mathrm{vol}(v),$$
where the infimum is taken over all real valuations $v$ of the function field of $Y$ centered at $y$, $A_{(Y,\Delta_Y)}(v)$ is the log discrepancy of $v$ with respect to $(Y,\Delta_Y)$, and $\mathrm{vol}(v)=\lim_{m\to\infty}\dim_{\mathbb{C}}(\mathcal{O}_{Y,y}/\mathfrak{a}_m(v))/(m^{\dim Y}/(\dim Y)!)$ is the volume of $v$.

A birational map $\varphi\colon X\dashrightarrow X'$ to a normal projective variety $X'$ (with $\Delta'$ the strict transform of $\Delta$ on $X'$, so that $(X',\Delta')$ is also klt and $K_{X'}+\Delta'$ is $\mathbb{Q}$-Cartier) is called $(K_X+\Delta)$-nonnegative if for every common resolution $p\colon W\to X$, $q\colon W\to X'$ one has
$$p^*(K_X+\Delta)\;-\;q^*(K_{X'}+\Delta')\;\geq\;0.$$

Prove or disprove: there exists a constant $\varepsilon=\varepsilon(X,\Delta)>0$ such that for every $(K_X+\Delta)$-nonnegative birational map $\varphi\colon X\dashrightarrow X'$ as above and every closed point $x\in X'$,
$$\widehat{\mathrm{vol}}(x,X',\Delta')\;\geq\;\varepsilon.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The question of a uniform positive lower bound on normalized volumes across all points appearing on $(K_X+\Delta)$-nonnegative birational models of a fixed klt pair is listed as an open problem in current surveys on K-stability and singularities. Existing results give pointwise positivity of the normalized volume (Li, Liu–Xu, Han–Liu–Qi) and uniform lower bounds in bounded families, but a uniform bound depending only on the fixed pair $(X,\Delta)$ across all MMP-type birational models has not been established in the literature surveyed.

status_evidence.title: Interaction between singularity theory and the MMP (Xu)
status_evidence.snippet: The lower bound for local volumes immediately gives a uniform bound for the Cartier index in any general type MMP... The normalized volume is non-decreasing along MMP-type contractions.
status_evidence.claim: Uniform lower bounds for normalized volumes are an active question linked to MMP, with partial results but no settled uniform statement of the form asked.

status_evidence.title: A guided tour to normalized volume (Li–Liu–Xu)
status_evidence.snippet: normalized volume function on klt singularities; positivity and minimization properties
status_evidence.claim: Survey of state of the art on normalized volumes; uniform bounds across birational models of a fixed pair are not asserted as theorems.
